column4: a recovery rate on defaulted Receivables of 40% of the outstanding principal balance thereof as of the time they were charged off as losses, with a lag time between default and recovery of three months, which reflects a determination by CarMax Business Services and the depositor considering, among other items, the composition of the pool of Receivables, experience with similar receivables, and the assumptions utilized by the NRSROs hired by CarMax Business Services to rate the Notes;
